scenes.spec_quote: areset is a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset that resets the history counter to zero.
When a branch prediction is made (predict_valid = 1), shift in predict_taken from the LSB side to update the branch history for the predicted branch.
When a branch misprediction occurs (train_mispredicted = 1), load the branch history register with the history after the completion of the mispredicted branch.
If both a prediction and misprediction occur at the same time, the misprediction takes precedence, because the pipeline flush will also flush out the branch that is currently making a prediction.
This is the history before the mispredicted branch (train_history) concatenated with the actual result of the branch (train_taken).
